description: Shared thin progress bar used by the criteria card (level-colored) and the plan cards (success-colored). Track + rounded fill, no magic numbers.

color.description: Fill color token. 'level' contexts pass the level's token color; plan contexts pass colors.success.

accessibility.label: {percent} percent
accessibility.note: Bar is always paired with a text value nearby (e.g. '3 of 5 criteria met') so it is never the sole carrier of meaning.
